post.originalText:
it's f*cking insane
2026 and i still haven't modeled a single building for my game

the whole city is a python script. claude fable 5.2 wrote it, blender rendered it, i just steered

neo-angeles, 2087:
> rain, neon, flying traffic between megatowers
> every block procedural, so no two streets repeat
> rebuild the entire city in one run if i don't like it
> camera flythrough rendered straight out of blender

repos if you want to build your own world:

1. ahujasid/blender-mcp
connects claude straight to blender. it can create objects, set materials, move the camera and render without you clicking anything

2. princeton-vl/infinigen
procedural world generator built on blender. terrain, plants, rocks and weather, all from code, all random but realistic

3. domlysz/BlenderGIS
pulls real maps, terrain and building footprints into blender. take a real city and turn it into a cyberpunk one

4. godotengine/godot
free open source engine. export the city from blender and walk around it in your own game

full prompt in the comments
